findings.claim: FY27 Q1（截至2026-06-30）：Defense 銷售 +40%（+$11.8M）、Energy & Process +5%；期末積壓訂單創高 $557.2M（+15%），其中約84%為國防
findings.source: Graham Corporation Reports First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results (Business Wire/Barchart, 2026-08-05)
findings.excerpt: Backlog at quarter end was a record $557.2 million, a 15% increase over the prior-year period, driven by strong bookings in the Defense and Space markets, and contributions from the FlackTek acquisition.

findings.claim: FY27 營收指引 $285–295M 維持；Q1 毛利率降至25.0%（前年26.5%），公司歸因於較高比重的低毛利國防銷售
findings.source: Graham Corporation Reports First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results (Business Wire/Barchart, 2026-08-05)

findings.claim: FY26 Q2（截至2025-09-30）：營收 +23% 至 $66.0M，毛利率降220bp至21.7%；積壓訂單 $500.1M，約85%為國防；新增 Space 訂單約$14.8M
findings.source: Graham Corporation Reports Second Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results (Business Wire, 2025-11-07)
